// Fixed scheduled protocol; execute only inside the root-granted outer limiter.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cpus, platform, arch } from 'node:os';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const [configuration, output] = process.argv.slice(2);
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(configuration, 'utf8'));
const modules = {};
for (const [label, variant] of Object.entries(config.variants))
  modules[label] = await import(pathToFileURL(variant.directory + '/packages/cil/src/index.js'));
const root = config.variants.after.directory;
const { assemblyFixture } = await import(pathToFileURL(root + '/tests/fixtures/assembly-index/fixture.mjs'));
const { typeFixture } = await import(pathToFileURL(root + '/tests/fixtures/symbol-search/fixture.mjs'));
const { queries, checkResult } = await import(pathToFileURL(root + '/tests/fixtures/symbol-search/queries.mjs'));
const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
const images = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => assemblyFixture(index + 1, 1000));
const loaded = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(modules).map(([label, { AssemblyInspector }]) =>
  [label, images.map(bytes => new AssemblyInspector(bytes))]));
const types = typeFixture();
const large = new modules.after.AssemblyInspector(types);
const samples = [], summaries = {};
const report = { config, host: `${platform()} ${arch()} ${cpus()[0].model}`, node: process.version,
  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  protocol: { existingControlPairs: 20, controlWarmups: 5, controlIterations: 3, order: 'AB/BA alternating',
    searchRounds: 10, queryOrder: 'six cases in forward/reverse order on alternating rounds',
    queryStates: ['cold cache, including all normalization/preflight', 'warm cache immediately after cold'],
    timedQueryIterations: 1, queryWarmups: 0, gcBeforeEachCell: true, thresholdMs: 50,
    qualification: 'One fixed shared-host schedule; retain every sample, no retries/exclusions or noise/speed/heap causality claim.' },
  fixture: { authoredTypes: 50000, indexedTypesIncludingGlobal: 50001, bytes: types.length, sha256: hash(types),
    fixtureSourceSha256: hash(readFileSync(root + '/tests/fixtures/symbol-search/fixture.mjs')),
    queryCasesSha256: hash(readFileSync(root + '/tests/fixtures/symbol-search/queries.mjs')),
    harnessSha256: hash(readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url))) },
  queries, summaries, chronologicalSamples: samples };
const start = performance.now();

function summarize(values) {
  const sorted = [...values].sort((left, right) => left - right);
  return { medianMs: (sorted[Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) / 2)] + sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)]) / 2,
    p95Ms: sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length * 0.95) - 1], maxMs: sorted.at(-1) };
}

try {
  const controls = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(modules).map(([label, { AssemblySymbolIndex }]) =>
    [label, () => new AssemblySymbolIndex(loaded[label])]));
  assert.deepEqual(controls.before().storage, controls.after().storage);
  for (let warmup = 0; warmup < 5; warmup++) { controls.before(); controls.after(); }
  for (let pair = 0; pair < 20; pair++) for (const label of pair % 2 === 0 ? ['before', 'after'] : ['after', 'before']) {
    globalThis.gc?.();
    const sampleStart = performance.now();
    let index;
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 3; iteration++) index = controls[label]();
    const elapsedMs = performance.now() - sampleStart;
    assert.equal(index.size, 20120);
    samples.push({ control: 'existingIndex', label, pair, elapsedMs, perOperationMs: elapsedMs / 3,
      startOffsetMs: sampleStart - start });
  }
  summaries.existingIndex = Object.fromEntries(['before', 'after'].map(label => [label,
    summarize(samples.filter(item => item.control === 'existingIndex' && item.label === label).map(item => item.perOperationMs))]));
  for (let round = 0; round < 10; round++) for (const item of round % 2 ? [...queries].reverse() : queries) {
    const index = new modules.after.AssemblySymbolIndex([large]);
    assert.deepEqual(index.searchStorage, { entries: 0, bytes: 0 });
    for (const state of ['cold', 'warm']) {
      globalThis.gc?.();
      const sampleStart = performance.now();
      const result = index.search(item.query, { mode: item.mode, offset: item.offset ?? 0, limit: 37 });
      const elapsedMs = performance.now() - sampleStart;
      samples.push({ control: 'search50k', name: item.name, round, state, elapsedMs, startOffsetMs: sampleStart - start,
        resultCount: result.entries.length, logicalCache: index.searchStorage });
      checkResult(result, item);
    }
  }
  summaries.search50k = Object.fromEntries(queries.map(item => [item.name,
    Object.fromEntries(['cold', 'warm'].map(state => [state,
      summarize(samples.filter(sample => sample.control === 'search50k' && sample.name === item.name && sample.state === state)
        .map(sample => sample.elapsedMs))]))]));
  report.thresholdFailures = samples.filter(sample => sample.control === 'search50k' && sample.elapsedMs > 50);
  assert.equal(large.cache.size, 0);
  report.passed = report.thresholdFailures.length === 0;
} catch (error) {
  report.passed = false;
  report.error = { name: error.name, message: error.message };
  throw error;
} finally {
  writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ output, summaries, thresholdFailures: report.thresholdFailures?.length }, null, 2));
if (!report.passed) throw Error('50 ms search criterion failed; fixed raw schedule retained without repeats');
